notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These 2 were picked from the pc_nq_v3_15m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, a one-setting-at-a-time neighbor check on 2023–2024) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First convexity look at the NQ holdout. No price-path convexity strategy had been scored on NQ 2025 onward before (apart from the final-test of these same frozen picks), and only these 2, frozen beforehand, were run, so there's no selection among holdout results. Other strategy families were scored on NQ 2025+ earlier (see the data-access ledgers), and a convexity pick had already been scored on ES 2025+ before the NQ picks were run.

legs.settings_text: 15m bars, max-gap convexity over N = 5 bars, z-score over 25 bars, enter at |z| 0.5, every signal, net move at least 3 ATR, long + short, hold 1.5N bars, 2-ATR stop, EMA(50) trend filter, flat at the close
